description:
Cast Dance of the Dead by paying {1}{B}, returning Leonin Relic-Warder from your graveyard to the battlefield, and attaching Dance of the Dead to it.
Leonin Relic-Warder enters the battlefield, exiling Dance of the Dead.
Dance of the Dead leaves the battlefield, causing you to sacrifice Leonin Relic-Warder.
Leonin Relic-Warder leaves the battlefield, returning Dance of the Dead from exile to the battlefield.
Dance of the Dead enters the battlefield, returning Leonin Relic-Warder from your graveyard to the battlefield, and attaching Dance of the Dead to it.
Repeat from step 3.
